mapper.insert: insert into trading.usage_record ( contract_id, order_id, transfer_id, consumer_id, consumer_user_identity_code, provider_id, provide_user_identity_code, usage_type, usage_value, billable_usage, amount, source_type, source_status, recorded_at, raw_payload ) values ( #{contractId}, #{orderId}, #{transferId}, #{consumerId}, #{consumerUserIdentityCode}, #{providerId}, #{provideUserIdentityCode}, #{usageType}, #{usageValue}, #{billableUsage}, #{amount}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceStatus}, #{recordedAt}, #{rawPayload} )
mapper.select: select id, contract_id, order_id, transfer_id, consumer_id, consumer_user_identity_code, provider_id, provide_user_identity_code, usage_type, usage_value, billable_usage, amount, source_type, source_status, recorded_at, raw_payload from trading.usage_record where order_id = #{orderId} and transfer_id = #{transferId} order by id desc limit 1

select count(distinct u.order_id) as total_order_count, coalesce(sum(u.usage_value), 0) as total_usage_value, coalesce(sum(u.billable_usage), 0) as total_billable_usage, coalesce(sum(u.amount), 0) as total_amount, max(u.recorded_at) as latest_recorded_at from trading.usage_record u left join trading.trade_order o on o.id = u.order_id and o.deleted = 0 where 1 = 1

select date_trunc('day', u.recorded_at) as stat_date, coalesce(sum(u.usage_value), 0) as total_usage_value, coalesce(sum(u.billable_usage), 0) as total_billable_usage, coalesce(sum(u.amount), 0) as total_amount from trading.usage_record u left join trading.trade_order o on o.id = u.order_id and o.deleted = 0 where 1 = 1
group by date_trunc('day', u.recorded_at) order by stat_date asc
select count(1) from trading.usage_record u left join trading.trade_order o on o.id = u.order_id and o.deleted = 0 where 1 = 1

select u.id, u.order_id, o.order_no, u.contract_id, o.commodity_id, coalesce(o.commodity_name, o.commodity_id) as commodity_name, o.connector_id, u.transfer_id, u.usage_type, u.usage_value, u.billable_usage, u.amount, u.source_type, u.source_status, u.recorded_at from trading.usage_record u left join trading.trade_order o on o.id = u.order_id and o.deleted = 0 where 1 = 1
order by u.recorded_at desc, u.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

sql.if: and ( o.order_no like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or u.contract_id like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or o.commodity_id like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or o.commodity_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or u.transfer_id like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
